sourceReconciliation.appExpectation: The backup-promotion UI self-test requires proposal.projectId to equal dbx:project:desktop-backup-authoritative-recovery-promotion-self-test and proposal.batch.commands[0].kind to equal project.recovery.backup-promote. The apply guard also requires project.recovery.backup-promote.
sourceReconciliation.adapterBehavior: The adapter accepts preview operation dicebox.project.recovery.backup-promotion.preview and derives operation project.recovery.backup-promotion by removing the dicebox prefix and .preview suffix. It passes that value as both the project-store producer sourceId and command kind.
sourceReconciliation.proposalSessionBehavior: Project sessions accept provider-free project-store batches and require the batch base target to equal the session project ID, but do not enforce operation-specific command kinds for project-store batches.
sourceReconciliation.coreBatchBehavior: The core schema permits the generated project.recovery.backup-promotion command kind because it is a non-empty project operation; generic batch validation does not reconcile it with the backup-promote UI/apply contract.

boundedReproduction.approach: Call createProjectRecoveryProposalBatch with a synthetic exact backup-promotion preview and print the batch targetId, command kind, base revision, producer, and target authority.
boundedReproduction.targetFinding: The exact target ID is preserved; the failing invariant is the operation-specific command kind, not an ambiguous target or active-GM authority.

selectedNextBoundary.scope: Correct only the recovery proposal adapter's exact backup-promotion operation-to-command mapping so the generated project-store batch uses project.recovery.backup-promote, add focused regression coverage for exact target/producer/command identity, and validate locally. Do not build, launch, capture, approve, apply, prepare, delete, clean up, or mutate runtime state.
selectedNextBoundary.reason: The adapter is the narrow owner of preview-to-command normalization; changing generic session/core acceptance would broaden authority and hide the exact operation contract.
